question: What minimal quadratic relation on the central involution J alone simultaneously enforces both anticommutativity and non-vanishing trace inside the idempotent projector without external grading or basis choice?

responses_summary.grok:
The idempotent projector \(P\) is recovered intrinsically from the central involution via the linear expression
\[
P=\frac12(1+J).
\]
Any quadratic relation satisfied by \(J\) alone is therefore inher
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: J² = I with the projector (I+J)/2 idempotent forces tr(J) ≠ 0 under the odd-parity invariant; anticommutativity is recovered as the derived relation {J,·} = 0 on the orthogonal complement.
